title: Marblo Store item manifest (marblo.yaml)
description: Every installable item in the Marblo ecosystem — skill, MCP server, agent, workflow, knowledge pack, harness, or bundle — is described by a marblo.yaml that validates against this schema. The Marblo app reads these manifests to build the Store index and to install items by tag or commit SHA.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump only on breaking changes to this schema.

id.description: Globally unique, stable, kebab-case identifier. Never reused for a different item.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the Store.

version.description: SemVer of THIS manifest/item. For manifest-only external items, tracks the pinned upstream ref.

description.description: One or two sentences: what it does and when to install it.

tier.description: official = maintained by Marblo; verified = external, reviewed & source-pinned; community = external, unreviewed.

source.description: For external / manifest-only items: where the real code lives. Marblo installs from this pinned ref — it is NOT vendored into this repo.

ref.description: Tag or commit SHA to pin. Never a moving branch.

path.description: Subpath within the source repo, if not the root.

harnesses.description: Which agent harnesses this item works with.

permissions.description: Capabilities the item requests, surfaced to the user before install.

includes.description: For type=bundle only: ids of other registry items installed together.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for first-party items, or the upstream license for referenced ones.
